scope: Entailment against supplied reporting, not independent verification of real-world news. One response per case; no accuracy guarantee.

cases.name: synthetic-meta-profile-only
cases.notes: Topics only; no database nationality, position or affiliation enters the summary.

cases.name: conflicting-sources-no-majority
cases.notes: Both publishers keep their own positions; the club remains the denier.

cases.name: quoted-instruction-remains-data
cases.notes: The transcript contains the example; the output does not make Hale its speaker.

cases.name: retained-chelsea-2026-10-20
cases.notes: The title changes French-born into French. The body says transfer advice came from Chelsea, which the cited headline does not establish. It also skips earlier discussion topics despite the specified anchor procedure.

cases.name: distinct-developments-three-independent-developments,-three-keyed-slots
cases.notes: Three independent developments remain in separate entries with their sources. Announced is a stronger stylistic paraphrase of said, but the source explicitly attributes the statement to the club.

cases.name: one-result-single-result,-named-scorer
cases.notes: Result and scorer/minute match the source. The numeric guard rejects their combination into one sentence; this is not an observed swapped-number error.

cases.name: rumour-and-denial-rumour-with-its-denial-intact
cases.notes: Unnamed sourcing, lack of agreement and declined comment survive.

cases.name: late-qualification-late-correction-in-the-same-source
cases.notes: City Wire remains the outlet that corrected its report; no offer or deal is invented.

cases.name: unidentified-player-stays-unidentified
cases.notes: No name or completed retirement is supplied.

cases.name: scheduled-talks-not-completed-talks
cases.notes: Talks remain planned and not yet held.

cases.name: same-source-repeated-not-confirmation
cases.notes: Valley Press repeats Hill Journal in the source, but the output omits that intermediary and presents each as citing an unnamed source. It does not explicitly claim independent confirmation, but loses the shared origin.

cases.name: disagreement-order-reversed
cases.notes: Order reversal does not cause a completed move, invented reversal or switched denier.

cases.name: future-possibility-not-an-announcement
cases.notes: A question remains a question; the database venue is not supplied as its answer.

cases.name: numeric-facts-with-separate-subjects
cases.notes: 3–0, two goals and five saves remain attached to the correct subjects. Mechanical rejection comes from combined-clause number/name checks.

cases.name: source-corrects-venue-not-time
cases.notes: Corrected venue and unchanged time survive. The guard rejects the combined venue/time sentence.

cases.name: profile-topic-without-database-answer
cases.notes: Profile topics are summarized without the database answers.

cases.name: frozen-ac-milan-40
cases.notes: The 0–3/red-card report belongs to 조선일보, not TNT Sports. Early lead and a euro currency are added without the cited text. Multiple unrelated topics are grouped together.

cases.name: frozen-chicago-bears-40
cases.notes: The final entry attributes a live-show topic to Yahoo Sports although report_1 is Establish The Run. Its cited reports do not supply October 22 or Soldier Field. Several topics are merged.

cases.name: frozen-la-clippers-40
cases.notes: Bodies largely follow the three selected Yahoo Sports headlines; no new event invention was identified. Kawhi Leonard is spelled out in other packet reports (13, 14, 40) but not cited report_31. The parser first rejects canonical LA Clippers where report_11 says Clippers. Distinguish citation/alias issues from invented events.

short_prompt_control.name: unidentified-player-stays-unidentified
short_prompt_control.notes: Preserves the unnamed player and uncertainty; adds a publication-date aside that the guard rejects.

short_prompt_control.name: scheduled-talks-not-completed-talks
short_prompt_control.notes: Preserves the planned meeting and that talks have not occurred.

short_prompt_control.name: same-source-repeated-not-confirmation
short_prompt_control.notes: Also loses the shared Hill Journal origin; adds publication dates that trigger validation.

short_prompt_control.name: disagreement-order-reversed
short_prompt_control.notes: Preserves the two positions but drops the publisher names required for attribution.

short_prompt_control.name: future-possibility-not-an-announcement
short_prompt_control.notes: Turns the question into a report of a possibility; candidate more directly preserves it as a question.

short_prompt_control.name: numeric-facts-with-separate-subjects
short_prompt_control.notes: Facts are supported and the guard accepts the separate result sentence.

short_prompt_control.name: source-corrects-venue-not-time
short_prompt_control.notes: Facts are supported; the existing guard rejects venue/time association.

short_prompt_control.name: profile-topic-without-database-answer
short_prompt_control.notes: Imports founding year, venue and manager from meta and falsely says the headline provides them.
